title: 01 · Pricing table, glass (Gloaming)
strengths: A real idea: one near-white lit plan with ink text inside a dark page, so the hierarchy is a single bright object rather than three equal cards
Confident type: Instrument Serif at one weight for names and the 90 px prices, Geist for everything else; the $ superscript and tabular 'Render-minutes 600 / mo' rows read as product

Believable, consistent numbers ($19 x 12 = $228 billed yearly, 'save $60'; '2,400 pooled' minutes; '3 seats min.') and real states in context (hover, pressed, focus, loading, disabled, 'Current plan')
slop_signals: The projector beam is a wedge with two visible hard edges converging above 'MOST PICKED'; a glow with a visible edge reads as a CSS gradient, not light
Coloured glows at the card corners: a teal bloom at the bottom-left of 'Spark' and an amber bloom under 'Studio' (decorative glow for no reason)
Viewfinder corner marks in the four page corners and the 'SC 01 / SC 02 / SC 03' slate numbers are decoration with no job
'$51 per seat, monthly' next to 'Billed yearly, 3 seats min.' contradicts itself; copy a real page would not ship
fixes: Feather the beam edges out completely (or replace it with a single soft radial light behind the Studio card, as Clay and Chronicle do)
Remove the teal and amber corner blooms; keep the amber only in the 'MOST PICKED' pill and the arrow
Drop the viewfinder marks and slate numbers
Rewrite Premiere's price line: '$51 per seat / month, billed yearly, 3 seats minimum'

references.what: Same dark three-card layout with a lifted middle plan; flat near-black cards and a mono billing toggle, no beam or glow, and it still holds
Only the Pro card is tinted from inside; the light stays inside the card instead of being cast on the page
'-20%' chips sit on the plan names, not in the toggle; a comparison grid with hairlines and no decoration
Dark pricing with the save chip inside the yearly/monthly toggle, the same device as ours
'Most Popular' tab on the card's top edge, as our 'MOST PICKED' pill

changed: Rebuilt as Gloaming's pricing page at real size: a plan table (label column with the billing toggle, three 300 px plan columns, grouped rows with units) instead of a component sheet with a states column
Projector beam, teal and amber blooms, glass, grain, viewfinder corners and slate numbers removed; the one idea is a single lit (near-white) Studio column in a dark page, with no tag and no overhang

Prices re-derived and re-added: Studio $19/$24 ($228 a year, saves $60); Premiere $48/$60 a seat, 1,800 render-minutes a seat pooled, extras $0.035 so overage never undercuts included minutes; 3 seats $1,728 a year or $180 a month; finished film 5 / 40 / 120 min
Type: Instrument Serif 51/38/28 and Geist 21/16/12; billing lines and table values at 16 px; weights 400 and 500
Engine: depth dial 90 to 35 (no glass) and rebuild; accent.dark.9 is now the exact brand #F2A93B
States one per frame: shot-monthly, shot-hover, shot-loading, shot-current (usage 412 of 600, quiet downgrade link), shot-focus
Fresh-eyes audit 3/5, then 4/5; all six remaining notes fixed
